name: mcp.schedule.add
rests_on: agents-harness CLI add dynamic schedule or reminder; exit 0 = added

text.description: Reminder text or message content to deliver

at.description: Due time: relative like '+10m', '+1h', '+2d', or ISO datetime '2026-09-05T20:00:00Z'. Provide at, cron, or cadence.

name.description: Optional short slug/identifier for the schedule

channel.description: Target channel. Inherited from the current turn when omitted. Required with text unless verb is set.

user.description: Target user or chat ID. Inherited from the current turn when omitted.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for naive ISO datetimes and cron (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Inherited from the current user when omitted.

prompt.description: Routine prompt. The harness stores the job and hands it to the registered routine handler instead of sending fixed text.

session.description: Routine session id. Defaults to routine:<name>.

timeout_sec.description: Per-job timeout in seconds. LLM reminders and routines default to 300.
